▚ CLOCKSCAPES

Keys and storage

This is Clockscapes . It collects nothing about you, as its privacy policy explains.

1–4 zones. “Find” looks up coordinates and time zone for the label using Open-Meteo. Weather refreshes every 10 minutes; everything is stored only in this browser (IndexedDB).
Keys: S settings · F fullscreen · M music · N next song · G the next hourly event, such as Big Ben · Esc close.
Made by utopick on GitHub, where the code is too.

Weather and places

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com, under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence (CC BY 4.0). Clockscapes changes the data: it turns the current conditions into the sky, rain, snow and fog of each scene, and shows the temperature and a short description.

The FIND button's place search uses the Open-Meteo geocoding API, which is based on GeoNames (CC BY 4.0). The free Open-Meteo API is for non-commercial use, and Clockscapes is free.

The app

Clockscapes is open source under the MIT licence. The clock font is Nunito, copyright 2014 The Nunito Project Authors, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The capitals' coordinates are adapted from countries_cities_data. The other cities and every city's population come from GeoNames (CC BY 4.0), and which cities are on the coast was worked out from the Natural Earth coastline (public domain). The pictures and the music are made by the app's own code.

Alarms (this device’s time)

Each alarm rings daily at this device’s time and its message crosses the clocks for a minute; tap a clock to stop it.

The app also rings it as a phone alarm, even when closed.
